column2: Bob Dylan contributed as Written-By, Backing Vocals, and Organ on “Experience Hendrix,” “The Best Of Peter, Paul And Mary,” “Johnny Cash At San Quentin,” and “Rattle And Hum.” He is credited on 18162 records across Discogs.
Nate Haessly is credited as Engineer, Recorded By on Sigur Rós’ “Átta” and Mitski’s “The Land Is Inhospitable And So Are We.” He is listed as a contributor on a total of 69 records across Discogs.
Laura Moody played cello on “Romance” by Fontaines D.C. and “Átta” by Sigur Rós. She is credited on 74 records across Discogs.
Dan Wallin was Mixed By and Engineer on “Annie (Original Motion Picture Soundtrack)” and “Camelot (Original Motion Picture Sound Track).” He is credited on 270 records across Discogs.
Kevin Killen mixed and engineered “Lazarus” and “Rattle And Hum.” He is credited on 467 records across Discogs.

Chris Galland is credited as Mixed By (Assistant Mixers), Mixed By (Assisted), and Engineer (Mixing Engineer) on “Chris” by Christine And The Queens and “Born To Die” by Lana Del Rey. He has been involved in the mixing of 523 records across Discogs.

Tom Elmhirst mixed “Lazarus” by Original New York Cast Of Lazarus, David Bowie And Enda Walsh (2) and “The Rise & Fall Of A Midwest Princess” by Chappell Roan. He is credited with mixing 716 records across Discogs.
Eddie Kramer was Engineer and Producer on “Experience Hendrix - The Best Of Jimi Hendrix” and “1” by The Beatles. He is credited with work on 720 records across Discogs.

Greg Kurstin is credited as Bass, Engineer, Written-By, Percussion, Producer, Electric Guitar, Drums, Keyboards, and Synthesizer on “Trustfall” by P!NK and “Damn.” by Kendrick Lamar. He has been credited on 838 records across Discogs.
Adam Clayton is credited as Written-By and Bass Guitar on “Damn” by Kendrick Lamar and “Rattle And Hum” by U2. He is listed as a contributor on 918 records across Discogs.
Larry Mullen is credited as Drums and Written-By on “Damn” by Kendrick Lamar and “Rattle And Hum” by U2. He is listed on 918 records across Discogs.
Manny Marroquin mixed “Chris” by Christine And The Queens and “Born To Die” by Lana Del Rey. He is credited on 1622 records across Discogs.
